items.title: Cyberpunk 2077 mod lets players create their own Night City missions
items.summary: This free mod should help keep you busy until Cyberpunk 2
items.content:
You need to check out this Cyberpunk 2077 free mod!

Cyberpunk 2077 players now have a new way to get creative, with a mod that lets them create their own missions in the seedy streets of Night City; all while we wait for Project Orion , the upcoming sequel.

Despite its terrible launch, CD Projekt RED’s Cyberpunk 2077 is now widely considered to be one of the best RPGs of all time, alongside The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt .

This sci-fi, open-world RPG takes place in Night City, where players control V, a mercenary navigating the criminal underworld. With branching storylines, meaningful choices and cybernetic augmentations that can turn V into a superhuman, the game already offers plenty of freedom. However, this new free mod, ‘Cyberpunk Contracts’, takes that player choice even further.

Cyberpunk Contracts is a newly released mod created by EdenisB , and it’s free to download now via NexusMods.

“Build your own gigs in Night City. Drop NPCs, trigger zones and doors where you stand, give them rules (when V gets close, the guard draws and opens fire), then press Test and play it. Missions save as small files you can share,” reads the description of the mod .

However, this is something you need to know before downloading ‘Cyberpunk Contracts’. To get started, you'll need a few other mods, including Cyber Engine Tweaks (CET), Codeware and RED4ext. These are modding tools that expand Cyberpunk 2077 's capabilities, allowing other mods to add new features and functionality to the game.

READ MORE: 13 best Cyberpunk 2077 mods that feel essential for PC players

It is also worth keeping in mind that with this being an early-released mod, it’s probably a bit rough around the edges right now, so expect some bugs. But hopefully, you won't encounter too many, and if you do, they’ll get fixed soon.

Lastly, as is the case with all other Cyberpunk 2077 mods, ‘Cyberpunk Contracts’ is a PC exclusive.

Cyberpunk 2077 is out now on PC, PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X/S and Nintendo Switch 2.

items.title: PlayStation Plus Free Game Is A 10/10 100-Hour Open-World RPG Masterpiece
items.summary: This PS+ RPG masterpiece is 100% worth playing.
items.content:
The PlayStation Plus logo surrounded by a black background. By Tom Wilson Published Oct 10, 2026, 9:30 AM EDT Tom Wilson is a Gaming Features Writer at Screen Rant. Over the past five years, Tom has worked as the Editor-in-Chief at The Game Crater, as a Staff Writer for GamingIntel, a List Writer at TheGamer, and, of course, as a Senior Writer at ScreenRant. Tom has experience writing reviews, guides, news, and features, and has been responsible for teams of writers, training them and editing their work. Tom graduated with a Masters in Multimedia Journalism, and has since gone on to build up his portfolio of games journalism work. Sign in to your ScreenRant account Add Us Summary Generate a summary of this story Like Like follow Follow followed Followed Listen Thread Log in Here is a fact-based summary of the story contents: Try something different: Show me the facts Explain it like I’m 5 Give me a lighthearted recap PlayStation Plus is awash with an abundance of phenomenal games, ranging from the very greatest RPGs all the way to the most charming of indies. You'd be hard-pressed to come away from the platform having found nothing to enjoy, especially with just how much variety is on offer. However, with how much PS+ costs these days, and our already limited time seemingly dwindling faster than ever before, one must truly get their money's worth by playing only the very best games, at least for the most part.

Sure, it's fun to indulge in a fun yet average title every now and then, but for those who want to maximize their investment in the service, they'll want to hear exclusively about the very best games on PlayStation Plus . Fortunately, I have just the title: a game that, while very much a popular entity that has more than pierced the zeitgeist and become a cultural touchstone, nevertheless deserves to be spotlighted time after time, if only so that those in the back, and those just joining our wonderful hobby, can learn all about it.

With new games coming to PlayStation Plus all the time, many shrink-wrapped in the shiny veneer of novelty, it can be easy to overlook existing titles, especially if your sole aim is to experience as many games or, at the very least, the newer releases. However, while the latest games released on PS+ certainly are an attractive option, one mustn't veer too far away from the service's vast selection of older masterpieces, titles that may have already enjoyed a long stint on the platform and have started to gather dust.

Chief among these soon-to-be-considered relics is the truly exceptional and perhaps over-discussed open-world RPG, Cyberpunk 2077 . It is unequivocally CD Projekt Red's magnum opus, its tight gunplay, stunning open world, philosophically dense narrative, litany of transformative updates, and beautifully written cast of characters making it a timeless epic that will almost assuredly enjoy an enduring legacy for quite some time.

It is also the type of game that has something for everyone, even should its neon-soaked setting or penchant for star-laden casts prove a turnoff for some. The narrative has the emotional highs and lows one would expect from a moving fable, JRPG, or cinematic blockbuster; its first-person shooting mechanics appeal to both the broadest audience and those eager for a little more strategy in their taking down of gang members, and its open-world, while admittedly seeped in cyberpunk tropes, is packed full of side content that will keep even the most active of players busy for quite some time.

A character wielding a blade in Cyberpunk 2077 It is true that Cyberpunk 2077 has been discussed to death, a title so immediately recognizable that many, especially those who've already enjoyed it or those who're still sitting teetering on the proverbial fence, will elect to ignore any further recommendations to play it. However, while I am sure I could offer little more meaningful insight into exactly why Cyberpunk 2077 is considered to be one of the greatest open-world sci-fi games of all time, I do still feel it is worth mentioning that it is a title everyone should experience at least once.

Sure, there will be facets of its gameplay that simply do not appeal. Still, the experience of venturing out of your Megabuilding for the first time, soaking in the steam, sights, shuffling masses, and blaring sun presiding over the perpetually alive city as a final reminder of the only natural thing left in this warped and beautiful city, is a profoundly impactful one that is worth the price of admission alone. Of course, said price is utterly free should you opt to try it through PlayStation Plus, something that I, once again, highly recommend you do.

Even today, after numerous playthroughs of both the base game and its DLC, after having completed every main and side mission, grinded the NCPD Scanner Hustles, and blasted the heads off of as many foes as I could find, I long to return to Night City one more time, to cruise around, listening to music, and, inevitably, crashing into a rogue NPC that thinks leaping into the road is a smart choice. If you have PlayStation Plus , do yourself a favor and play Cyberpunk 2077 .

CDPR Issues New Official Statement on Cyberpunk 2077's Live-Action Movie From GameRant (Written by Joshua Duckworth) on October 9, 2026 | OpenCritic

Video game adaptations have become a major part of Hollywood's plans, with studios increasingly looking to established gaming franchises for their next big releases, and a new adaptation is coming for Cyberpunk 2077 . Even Xbox has opened a new division with the intent of expanding its IP beyond video games, so the increase in these video game adaptations should surprise no one. From live-action adaptations to animated series, recognizable games are finding new audiences beyond consoles and PC. For developers, these projects also offer an opportunity to expand their fictional worlds without replacing the games that made them popular in the first place.

Few modern RPGs have built a world quite like Cyberpunk 2077 . CD Projekt Red's action-adventure game takes players to Night City, a sprawling metropolis where advanced technology, corporate power, and underground crime collide. Its setting has since expanded beyond the original game through additional content and other media like Cyberpunk: Edgerunners , making the franchise a natural candidate for another adaptation. Now, its next major screen project is beginning to take shape.

items.title: Paramount Pictures adapting live-action movie set in Cyberpunk 2077 universe, co-produced by CD Projekt Red
items.summary: "We're excited about Paramount as a future partner who shares our creative ambitions for the Cyberpunk franchise," said CDPR co-CEO Michał Nowakowski
items.content:
"We're excited about Paramount as a future partner who shares our creative ambitions for the Cyberpunk franchise," said CDPR co-CEO Michał Nowakowski

Image credit: CD Projekt Red News by Sophie McEvoy Staff Writer Published on Oct. 9, 2026, 12:54 p.m. Follow CD Projekt RED Paramount Pictures is adapting a live-action film set in the Cyberpunk 2077 universe.

According to Deadline , CD Projekt Red will co-produce the film with Transformers producer Lorenzo di Bonaventura.

"We're excited about Paramount as a future partner who shares our creative ambitions for the Cyberpunk franchise," said CDPR co-CEO Michał Nowakowski . "We look forward to sharing more details at the appropriate time."

Since 2022, CDPR has produced the Netflix anime series Cyberpunk: Edgerunners with animation studio Trigger. The second season will premiere later this month .

CDPR is currently focused on The Witcher 4 , having expanded its team to 513 developers over the summer. CDPR's Boston studio has also started work on a sequel to Cyberpunk 2077 .

Recent video game adaptations for film and television have positively impacted franchise back catalogues. Analysts told GamesIndustry.biz that Zach Cregger's Resident Evil movie increased Capcom's Resident Evil player engagement by 50% before and after its release.

The second season of Amazon's Fallout adaptation quickly became the sixth most-watched series of all time. Following its premiere, the number of concurrent Fallout players on Steam more than doubled.

Other video game adaptations currently in the works at Paramount include the upcoming Street Fighter film co-produced with Legendary, and a movie based on the Call of Duty franchise directed by Peter Berg.

Earlier this week, Paramount completed its $111 billion acquisition of Warner Bros. Discovery , with both companies operating under the name Skydance.

As part of the deal, Paramount Games Studio and WB Games merged under Skydance . Skydance president Andy Gordon emphasised the company's transmedia goals across games, experiences, consumer products, and publishing.

"These are core pillars of our strategy to build engagement and fandom in both the physical and digital worlds. We want to meet consumers where they watch, play, and engage. At the same time, we see opportunities to build on DC Comics' storytelling and expand our e-commerce offerings to connect fans with the brands they love."

items.title: Cyberpunk 2077 movie adaptation from Paramount on the way
items.summary: The smash hit from the studio behind The Witcher series is to be turned into a film by Paramount Pictures.
items.content:
Share Save Add as preferred on Google Tom Richardson BBC Newsbeat CD Projekt Red The Cyberpunk 2077 video game featured Keanu Reeves in one of the main roles A live-action movie version of smash hit video game Cyberpunk 2077 is being developed by Paramount Pictures.

The Hollywood studio is working with producer Lorenzo di Bonaventura, known for his work on the Transformers films, and CD Projekt Red (CDPR), the developer of the sci-fi role-playing game.

CDPR's joint-chief executive Michał Nowakowski said in a statement the company was "excited about Paramount as a future partner who shares our creative ambitions for the Cyberpunk franchise".

Details of the film's story, potential release date and casting information are yet to be revealed.

Despite a troubled launch in 2020 , the Cyberpunk 2077 video game, which stars Keanu Reeves, has sold more than 40 million copies worldwide.

The John Wick star plays rockstar Johnny Silverhand, a terrorist whose consciousness is stored on a chip inside the body of main character V.

Set in Night City, a fictional metropolis in a dystopian version of California, players work to uncover a conspiracy involving the shady Arasaka megacorporation.

An expansion, Phantom Liberty, starring Idris Elba was released in 2023 and has sold more than 15 million copies, according to CDPR.

Cyberpunk has already been successfully adapted into a popular animated series - Edgerunners - with a second season due to premiere on Netflix later this month.

The streamer also produced The Witcher, an adaptation of CDPR's massively popular fantasy role-playing series.

It originally starred former Superman actor Henry Cavill, but he was replaced by Liam Hemsworth in the show's fourth season.

Multiple video game series have been adapted for TV and film in recent years, with more due to follow.

Two Super Mario movies, a big screen version of Minecraft and a series of Sonic the Hedgehog films have each seen global box office takings of about $1bn.

PlayStation game The Last of Us was made into a hit series by HBO, and Prime Video says its adaptation of post-apocalyptic role-playing series Fallout is one of its most-watched programmes.

Cyberpunk 2077 Is The Latest Video Game To Get The Movie Treatment
items.summary: Paramount Pictures will develop the film and CD Projekt Red will produce.
items.content:
Paramount Pictures will develop the film and CD Projekt Red will produce.

CD Projekt Red Add Engadget on Google: Preferred Source Google Discover Movie adaptations of video games are currently doing a brisk business, and today brings a new title into the fold. Deadline reports that Paramount Pictures is working on a live-action film set in the world of Cyberpunk 2077 , a narrative-driven RPG from CD Projekt Red. The game developer is attached to produce the movie along with Lorenzo di Bonaventura, whose past producer credits on action movies run the gamut from Red and Shooter to The Meg and several Michael Bay Transformers flicks.

It's unclear whether this is a separate endeavor from the early-stage news of a production deal with Anonymous Content announced back in 2023. Today's report is also very preliminary, with no suggestions of a plot or cast.

CD Projekt Red's Cyberpunk 2077 is already itself an adaptation of a tabletop game, so it's perhaps not a surprise that it would continue to inspire a ripple effect of retellings. The video game world of Night City has already provided fodder for the anime series Cyberpunk: Edgerunners on Netflix, which is about to return for a second season .

items.title: Paramount Will Follow ‘Street Fighter’ and ‘Call of Duty’ With ‘Cyberpunk 2077’
Live-Action Cyberpunk 2077 Movie In Development At Paramount
items.summary: Hollywood continues its rush to make more video game adaptations following Mario and Minecraft success
items.content:
Cyberpunk 2077 Keanu Reeves Live-action movie Paramount

Cyberpunk 2077 is the latest video game reportedly making the leap to the big screen via a movie from Paramount.

On October 8, Deadline and Variety both reported that a live-action Cyberpunk 2077 film was in the works. Transformers producer Lorenzo di Bonaventura is connected to the in-development project. Witcher and Cyberpunk 2077 studio CD Projekt Red is also involved and will help produce the upcoming project, which is still very early in development.

No story details or information on casting, writers, or directors was shared by either outlet.

“We’re excited about Paramount as a future partner who shares our creative ambitions for the Cyberpunk franchise. We look forward to sharing more details at the appropriate time,” said CDPR’s joint CEO Michał Nowakowski on Twitter .

Cyberpunk 2077 has been a massive hit for CD Projekt Red. Following a rough launch in 2020 , the first-person sci-fi open-world RPG has received numerous free updates as well as a massive paid DLC in the form of 2023’s Phantom Liberty. Cyberpunk 2077, which features Keanu Reeves as Johnny Silverhand, has sold over 40 million copies worldwide. A sequel from CD Projekt Red is in the works .

This is just one more video game movie adaptation to toss on the pile. Over the last few years, video games have become big business in Hollywood. TV shows like Fallout and The Last of Us have been mega hits for Amazon and HBO, respectively. Meanwhile, movies like Sonic, Minecraft, Super Mario, and the recently released Resident Evi l have proved that the era of video game movies being flops that nobody likes is well and truly over. Now Hollywood is desperate to turn every big game into a movie, including stuff like Arc Raiders.

For Paramount, this news comes shortly after the company officially merged with Warner Bros. to create the new company Skydance, led by rich failson and terrible actor David Ellison . Bobby Kotick, former CEO of Activision, was recently named a member of the new company’s board .

items.content:
Patch 2.31 for Cyberpunk 2077 is now live!

This update includes an AutoDrive upgrade and Photo Mode adjustments. It also addresses common issues encountered by players. For details, check the full list of changes below:

Vehicles

  • Updated AutoDrive. When driving to a selected point, the vehicle now drives smoothly, overtakes blocking vehicles and no longer stops at traffic lights. Free Roam mode has also been upgraded to follow traffic rules and navigate the city more reliably.

    [/*]

  • Fixed an issue where Johnny always spawned in the passenger seat when using the Delamain Cab service.

    [/*]

  • Fixed an issue where applying CrystalCoat to the Yaiba ARV-Q340 Semimaru caused its wheels to flash in different colors.

    [/*]

Photo Mode

  • Most of the new poses introduced in Update 2.3 now work with any gender.

    [/*]

  • Disabled NPC collision, which will make it easier to position NPCs on top of other objects with collision (e.g. on car hoods).

    [/*]

  • Fixed an issue where some of the poses didn't work for Royce.

    [/*]

Quests & Open World

  • Freedom - Fixed the journal entry that appears when the player chooses not to steal the Rayfield Caliburn "Mordred."

    [/*]

  • Motorbreath - Fixed an issue where, after V fails to pursue and stop Semimaru and receives a text from River saying he'll contact V soon, the follow-up message never arrives.

    [/*]

  • Motorbreath - Fixed an issue where the Yaiba Semimaru could flip over during the chase, preventing the player from entering it.

    [/*]

  • Motorbreath - It's no longer possible to trigger the quest if River died during The Hunt.

    [/*]

  • Motorbreath - Players can now acquire the Yaiba ARV-Q340 Semimaru through AUTOFIXER even if they failed The Hunt, which normally unlocks the side quest where the vehicle is obtained.

    [/*]

  • Nitro (Youth Energy) - Fixed a game crash that could occur in certain circumstances after leaving the Yaiba showroom event.

    [/*]

  • Nitro (Youth Energy) - Fixed an issue where the proxy interface UI in the Yaiba showroom is cut off when the "Larger HUD Elements" setting is enabled.

    [/*]

Miscellaneous

  • Fixed several localization and lipsync issues in various languages.

    [/*]

  • Added a toggle to disable vignette. It can be found in Settings → Graphics → Basic.

    [/*]

  • Fixed an issue on PC and Mac where Ray-Traced Reflections might not display correctly when enabled under certain conditions.

    [/*]

  • Fixed several issues with displaying text messages from Delamain.

    [/*]

  • Various fixes for fluff vendors.

    [/*]

PC-specific

  • Fixed an issue where NVIDIA Reflex could be disabled while DLSS Frame Generation was enabled, causing the screen to turn pink.

    [/*]

  • Fixed an issue where Path Tracing didn't activate properly in certain scenarios.

    [/*]

Mac-specific

  • Fixed an issue where changing graphics presets on Mac set Screen Space Reflections to a higher setting compared to the equivalent presets on PC.

    [/*]

  • Fixed an issue causing a permanent white screen when Frame Generation is enabled while entering the braindance in The Information.

    [/*]

  • Selecting "Defaults" in Video Settings no longer turns HDR Mode off.

    [/*]

  • Fixed an issue where setting the MetalFX DRS Maximum Resolution above the value applied by the “For this Mac” preset could cause visual artifacts.

    [/*]

  • Fixed the inverted behavior of the "Mute Game in Background" toggle in Settings.

    [/*]

  • Removed the outdated "(Requires Game Restart)" disclaimer from the mouseover description of the "Disable Spatial Audio" setting.

    [/*]

  • Fixed an issue on the App Store version that caused the game to become stuck on the “Press Space to continue” breaching screen.

    [/*]

  • Various stability and performance optimizations.

    [/*]

Surviving the City of Dreams is tough, but a choom at your side can make all the difference.

In our latest It’s All About You episode, we’re celebrating all of our iconic duos living on the edge! Night City wouldn’t shine quite so bright without them. 

Thank you for staying with us and expressing your love for Cyberpunk: Edgerunners in the most creative ways possible. Don't forget to check out our gallery to see more works, and, of course, share your creations with us: http://cdpred.ly/AAY. See you in the next episode!

items.content:
Update 2.3 lands tomorrow!

Experience Night City in a whole new way — this patch introduces 4 new vehicles, the AutoDrive feature, self-driving Delamain cabs and more! It also contains updates for CrystalCoat™ and Photo Mode, as well as support for AMD FSR 3.1 Frame Generation, Intel XeSS 2.0 and HDR10+ Gaming, among others.

Update 2.3 also brings Cyberpunk 2077 to a whole new platform: Mac with Apple silicon! If you already own the game on Steam, you can play it on your compatible device. To find out whether your Mac can run Cyberpunk 2077, please check the official requirements.

Read the list of changes for more info:

Vehicles

  • Added 4 new vehicles, including several Side Jobs tied to acquiring them:

    • Yaiba ARV-Q340 Semimaru

      Reward from a new side job (to unlock, complete The Hunt and The Beast In Me).

      An additional side job unlocks the CrystalCoat™ feature for it.

      [/*]

    • Rayfield Caliburn "Mordred"

      Reward from a new side job (to unlock, complete The Beast in Me: Badlands, The Beast in Me: Santo Domingo, Transmission, and Search and Destroy)."

      [/*]

    • Yaiba ASM-R250 Muramasa

      Reward from a new side job (to unlock, purchase 1 Yaiba vehicle, purchase at least 3 vehicles through AUTOFIXER, and complete Reported Crime: You Play with Fire...).

      If you fail the side job, the vehicle can later be purchased through AUTOFIXER.

      [/*]

    • Chevillon Legatus 450 Aquila

      Available for purchase on AUTOFIXER.

      [/*]
    [/*]

  • Introducing AutoDrive! This cutting-edge, autonomous driving feature will take you to your chosen destination (i.e. job objective or placed pin on the map). If you have no set destination, it will take you on a leisurely ride through the streets of Night City. Simply hop in any of your vehicles, make sure you're on a road, and hold G (PC) / Left Stick (consoles) to activate. This feature is disabled when you enter combat or when your vehicle is heavily damaged.

    [/*]

  • Implemented Cinematic Camera for AutoDrive. Hold Q (PC) / D-Pad Right (consoles) to activate. Sit back and enjoy cinematic views of Night City as you cruise toward your destination.

    [/*]

  • Self-driving Delamain cabs are now available on demand! Simply open the menu to call vehicles, then select "Delamain Cab" from the list to request a ride. This feature unlocks after completing the job Don't Lose Your Mind (regardless of outcome) and receiving a message from Delamain.

    [/*]

  • Rayfield's CrystalCoat™ is now available for vehicles from partner brands, including motorcycles. Additionally, the infamous hacker known as Cosmetic_Troll exploited a vulnerability and created a cracked version of Rayfield's CrystalCoat™ technology for lower-end vehicles. Please note, however, that some models do not support the technology, such as heavily modded nomad vehicles and job-related vehicles.

    [/*]

  • Fixed an issue where unique color schemes did not work properly on the Mizutani Shion MZ1 and MZ2.

    [/*]

  • Fixed an issue where unique color scheme could not be applied properly to the Villefort Deleon "Vindicator".

    [/*]

Photo Mode

  • Added 27 new NPCs that can be spawned in Photo Mode, including Rita Wheeler, the Cassel twins, fixers, Dum Dum, the iguana, Brendan, and more.

    [/*]

  • You can now switch between alternative outfits for NPCs spawned in Photo Mode.

    [/*]

  • You can now switch between V's saved Wardrobe outfits in Photo Mode.

    [/*]

  • Added a confirmation pop-up when exiting Photo Mode to prevent accidental exits after setting up the perfect shot.

    [/*]

  • Added more customization options to the Look-At Camera feature, including an option for only the character's eyes to turn toward the camera instead of their entire body.

    [/*]

  • Added improvements to Lighting:

    • Lights now spawn around the camera instead of the player character.

      [/*]

    • Added an outline to the spotlight mesh and an indicator when it's off screen for better visibility.

      [/*]

    • Improved light movement speed on controllers.

      [/*]
    [/*]

  • Added multiple new stickers and frames, including iconic quotes and stylish overlays that let you turn your screenshots into Night City postcards – perfect for sharing memories from the City of Dreams.

    [/*]

  • Improved Depth of Field and moved it to the Camera tab.

    [/*]

  • Added a new Color Balance tab, allowing you to create your own custom filters.

    [/*]

  • Added a new Time and Weather tab:

    • Weather: includes rain, acid rain, fog, sandstorm, pollution, and sunny.

      [/*]

    • Time of Day: changes the time of day within Photo Mode.

      [/*]

    • Frame Forward: advances through an unlimited amount of frames to capture the perfect shot.

      [/*]

    • Game Speed: allows in-game time to progress while in Photo Mode."

      [/*]
    [/*]

Quality of Life & Accessibility

  • The game will now detect if the player is using inverted mouse button settings and automatically adjusts in-game button prompts accordingly.

    [/*]

  • Added an option to toggle aiming down sights in Settings → Controls.

    [/*]

Jobs & Open World

  • Cyberpsycho Sighting: Bloody Ritual - the "Crack the ritualist's shard" objective now properly disappears from the Journal after completing the objective.

    [/*]

  • Sex on Wheels - now properly appears in the Journal after receiving the message from Jake Estevez.

    [/*]

  • Shot by Both Sides - fixed an issue where selecting a specific dialogue option in the conversation with Bree created a nameless, iconless item in the player's Inventory.

    [/*]

  • Shot by Both Sides - fixed an issue where the button to go to the lower level didn't appear on the elevator panel.

    [/*]

Gameplay

  • Fixed an issue where, when using a controller in Trauma Drama, the controllable character would default to shooting upwards instead of forward.

    [/*]

  • Players can now drop more Cyberware Capacity Shards if some within the intended drop limit were previously missed.

    [/*]

  • Fixed an issue causing automatic weapons to fire slower than intended.

    [/*]

  • Fixed an issue where the Official BARGHEST Tac Vest didn't drop from the scripted Airdrop as intended.

    [/*]

  • The level 60 Engineer perk no longer activates the EMP blast outside of combat or after entering a vehicle.

    [/*]

  • Added an option to replay the gameplay tutorial at any time via Settings → Controls.

    [/*]

Miscellaneous

  • Added an option to tell Johnny to go away after you look at him for a short while when he appears in the passenger seat. He takes the hint and disappears as a passenger for a couple days.

    [/*]

  • Fixed an issue where the sound of V's Radioport could be randomly interrupted by the Radioports of nearby NPCs.

    [/*]

  • Fixed an issue where History by Gazelle Twin and Trash Generation played too loudly compared to other songs on the radio.

    [/*]

  • Improved the HDR Setting screen: fixed the HDR calibration preview so it correctly reflects the chosen settings, and clarified the description of the "Tone-Mapping Midpoint" setting.

    [/*]

  • Updated the End User Licence Agreement. You will be asked to accept it again when you load the game after updating.

    [/*]

  • Fixed several visual issues with missing, clipping, or floating textures.

    [/*]

  • Fixed several localization issues in various languages.

    [/*]

PC-specific

  • Added support for AMD FidelityFX Super Resolution 4 for compatible AMD GPUs. IMPORTANT: The FSR 4 option will not be available in the in-game settings until the supporting AMD driver is installed. Please note that the driver will be released at a later date.

    [/*]

  • Added support for AMD FidelityFX Super Resolution Frame Generation 3.1 for compatible hardware. It can now be used in combination with any upscaler.

    [/*]

  • Added support for ​Intel XeSS 2.0, with XeSS Frame Generation available on compatible hardware.

    [/*]

  • Added support for HDR10+ GAMING certified Intel GPUs. To enable this feature, your display must support the technology (find my display) and have "Game Mode" enabled. The HDR10+ GAMING toggle can be found in Settings in the Video tab.

    [/*]

  • Fixed an issue where the DLSS Super Resolution Preset would invisibly revert from the CNN model to the Transformer model after restarting the game, even though the UI still displayed the CNN model as active.

    [/*]

  • Added more detailed information to the DLSS Super Resolution Preset tooltip in Settings to help players choose the best option for their setup.

    [/*]

  • Added the ability to move the mouse cursor to a different display while in Windowed Borderless mode.

    [/*]

  • Increased the maximum save size from 12 MB to 15 MB.

    [/*]

  • It will now be possible to rebind the key used to jump out of vehicles with the Stuntjock perk.

    [/*]
